一.（34分）将重物架在两圆柱上，当两圆柱静止时，使重物克服摩擦力沿圆柱轴向滑动（拉出）是较困难的，但若使圆柱按图示方向旋转，再使重物作同样的滑动将容易得多。然而，若圆柱旋转方向与图示方向相反，则使重物滑动将更难，甚至有可能产生“自锁”（无论施加多大拉力也无法拉动重物）。本题将从力学角度来讨论这一问题。设重物的质量为 $m$，它左右对称地架在同一水平面上的两平行圆柱上，两圆柱半径均为 $r$，绕轴旋转角速度大小均为 $\omega$，A、B 为重物与圆柱的切点，A、B 与圆柱轴心的连线与竖直方向的夹角均为 $\alpha$，重物与两圆柱间的摩擦系数均为 $\mu$。(1) 若两圆柱按图示方向旋转，求将重物沿圆柱轴向以匀速 $v_0$ 向外拉时，所需拉力 $F$ 的表达式。[18分] (2) 若两圆柱旋转方向与图中所示相反，求使重物做同样运动所需拉力 $F$ 的表达式，讨论产生“自锁”的可能性。[16分]

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-1.png)
questions.analysis:
(1) $\vec{v}' = v_0 \vec{k} - r\omega\cos\alpha \vec{i} - r\omega\sin\alpha \vec{j}$

$$\bar{f} = -f\frac{\vec{v}'}{v'} = -\mu N\frac{\vec{v}'}{v'}$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-答案-1.png)

$$\frac{\mu N}{\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2}}\left(r\omega\cos\alpha\vec{i}+r\omega\sin\alpha\vec{j}-v_0\vec{k}\right)$$

$$f_y = \frac{r\omega\sin\alpha}{\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2}}\mu N$$

$$f_z = -\frac{v_0}{\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2}}\mu N$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-答案-2.png)

$$2N\cos\alpha = mg - 2f_y = mg - \frac{2r\omega\sin\alpha}{\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2}}\mu N$$

$$\frac{mg\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2}}{2(\cos\alpha\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2}+\mu r\omega\sin\alpha)}$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-答案-3.png)

$$f_z = -\frac{\mu mg v_0}{2\left(\cos\alpha\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2}+\mu r\omega\sin\alpha\right)}$$

$$F + 2f_z = 0$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-答案-4.png)

$$F = -2f_z = \frac{\mu mgv_0}{\cos\alpha\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2}+\mu r\omega\sin\alpha}$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-答案-5.png)

$$f_y = \frac{r\omega\sin\alpha}{\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2}}\mu N,\quad f_z = -\frac{v_0}{\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2}}\mu N$$

(2) 假设物块能滑动，同理可求：

$$2(\cos\alpha\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2}-\mu r\omega\sin\alpha)$$

$$F = \frac{\mu mgv_0}{\cos\alpha\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2}-\mu r\omega\sin\alpha}$$

条件：$\cos\alpha\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2} > \mu r\omega\sin\alpha$

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-答案-6.png)

$$\mu\tan\alpha < \sqrt{1+\frac{v_0^2}{r^2\omega^2}}$$

$$\cos\alpha\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2} \leq \mu r\omega\sin\alpha$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-答案-7.png)

$$\mu\tan\alpha \geq \sqrt{1+\frac{v_0^2}{r^2\omega^2}}$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-答案-8.png)

$N < 0$，$F < 0$ 或 $N \to \infty$，$F \to \infty$ 无意义，不能滑动，产生自锁。
questions.answer:
(1) $F = \dfrac{\mu mgv_0}{\cos\alpha\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2}+\mu r\omega\sin\alpha}$

(2) $F = \dfrac{\mu mgv_0}{\cos\alpha\sqrt{v_0^2+r^2\omega^2}-\mu r\omega\sin\alpha}$；当 $\mu\tan\alpha \geq \sqrt{1+\dfrac{v_0^2}{r^2\omega^2}}$ 时产生自锁。

二.（42分）如图所示，半径为R的光滑半球面固定在水平地面上，长度为 $L = \pi R / 3$ ，总质量为m的匀质柔软链条置于球面上，初始链条保持静止，其左端刚好位于球面最高处。从静止开始释放链条。

(1)刚释放时，链条的加速度大小是多少？[8分]

(2)刚释放时，链条上什么位置张力最大，最大张力是多少？[8分]

(3)假设链条左端绕球心O转过角度 $\varphi \cong 10^{\circ}$ 时，链条没有飞离球面，求此时链条下滑的速度和加速度；[8分]

(4) 求 $\varphi   =   1 0 ^ { \circ }$ 时链条对球面的作用力（求出合力即可）；[10分]

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-2.png)

(5)链条右端着地之前，链条是否会部分脱离球面？如果会，求出脱离时链条左端绕球心O转过的角度 $\varphi _ { c }$如果不会，请说明理由[8分]。

$$\lambda = \frac{m}{L} = \frac{3}{\pi} \frac{m}{R}$$
$$\mathrm{d}T + \lambda R g \sin \theta \mathrm{d}\theta = \lambda R a \mathrm{d}\theta$$
$$\int _ { 0 } ^ { 0 } \mathrm { d } T + \lambda R g \int _ { 0 } ^ { \pi / 3 } \sin \theta \mathrm { d } \theta = \lambda R a \int _ { 0 } ^ { \pi / 3 } \mathrm { d } \theta$$
$$\frac{1}{2} \lambda R g = \frac{\pi}{3} \lambda R a$$
$$a = \frac { 3 } { 2 \pi } g$$
另解:
$$\mathrm{d}M = \mathrm{d}mg \cdot R\sin\theta = \lambda gR\mathrm{d}\theta \cdot R\sin\theta$$
$$= \lambda g R^{2} \sin \theta \mathrm{d} \theta \left( \lambda = \frac{m}{l} = \frac{3}{\pi} \frac{m}{R} \right)$$
$$M = \int_{0}^{\pi/3} \lambda g R^{2} \sin \theta \mathrm{d}\theta = \frac{1}{2} \lambda g R^{2}$$
$$\frac{1}{3} \pi \lambda R^{2} v, \quad \frac{\mathrm{d} L}{\mathrm{d} t} = \frac{1}{3} \pi \lambda R^{2} a$$
$$\frac{\mathrm{d}L}{\mathrm{d}t} \Rightarrow \frac{1}{2}\lambda g R^{2} = \frac{1}{3}\pi\lambda R^{2}a.$$
$$a   =   \frac { 3 } { 2 \pi } g$$
(2)
$$\int _ { 0 } ^ { \tau } \mathrm { d } T + \lambda R g \int _ { 0 } ^ { \theta } \sin \theta \mathrm { d } \theta = \lambda R a \int _ { 0 } ^ { \theta } \mathrm { d } \theta$$
$$T = \lambda R a \theta - \lambda R g ( 1 - \cos \theta )$$
$$\lambda R g \left( \frac{3}{2 \pi} \theta + \cos \theta - 1 \right)$$
$$\frac{\mathrm{d}T}{\mathrm{d}\theta}=\lambda Rg\left(\frac{3}{2\pi}-\sin\theta\right)$$
$$\left. \frac{\mathrm{d}T}{\mathrm{d}\theta} \right|_{\theta = \theta_{m}} = 0 \Rightarrow \sin \theta_{m} = \frac{3}{2\pi}, \quad \cos \theta_{m} = \sqrt{1 - \frac{9}{4\pi^{2}}}, \quad \theta_{m} \approx 0.498   rad$$
$$T_{\max} = \lambda R g \left( \frac{3}{2 \pi} \theta_m + \cos \theta_m - 1 \right)$$
根据角动量定理也可解。
$$\frac{3}{\pi}mg(\frac{3}{2\pi}\theta_{m}+\cos\theta_{m}-1)$$
$$\approx 0 . 1 1 1 m g$$
$$\mathrm{d}T + \lambda R g \sin \theta \mathrm{d}\theta = \lambda R a \mathrm{d}\theta$$
$$a = \frac{3}{2\pi}g, \lambda = \frac{3}{\pi}\frac{m}{R}$$
(3) 质心位置:
$$R_{c}=\frac{\int R\cos\theta\mathrm{d}m}{m}=\frac{\int_{-\pi/6}^{\pi/6}R\cos\theta\cdot\lambda R\mathrm{d}\theta}{\lambda(\pi R/3)}=\frac{3R}{\pi}$$
$$mgR_{c}\cos\frac{\pi}{6}=\frac{1}{2}mv^{2}+mgR_{c}\cos(\varphi+\frac{\pi}{6})$$
$$v = \sqrt{\frac{6gR}{\pi}} \left[ \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} - \cos\left(\varphi + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) \right] \approx 0.437\sqrt{gR}$$
$$a_{t} = \frac{\mathrm{d}v}{\mathrm{d}t} = \frac{\mathrm{d}v}{\mathrm{d}\varphi} \frac{\mathrm{d}\varphi}{\mathrm{d}t} = \frac{v}{R} \frac{\mathrm{d}v}{\mathrm{d}\varphi} = \frac{1}{2R} \frac{\mathrm{d}v^{2}}{\mathrm{d}\varphi}$$
$$\frac{3g}{\pi}\sin(\varphi + \frac{\pi}{6}) \approx 0.614g$$
另解:
$$\mathrm{d}T + \mathrm{d}mg\sin\theta = \mathrm{d}ma_{a}$$
$$\int_{\Omega} \mathrm{d}m = \lambda R \mathrm{d}\theta$$
$$\mathrm{d}T + \lambda R g \sin \theta \mathrm{d}\theta = \lambda R a_t \mathrm{d}\theta$$
$$\int _ { 0 } ^ { 0 } \mathrm { d } T + \lambda R g \int _ { \varphi } ^ { \varphi + \frac { \pi } { 3 } } \sin \theta \mathrm { d } \theta = \lambda R a _ { t } \int _ { \varphi } ^ { \varphi + \frac { \pi } { 3 } } \mathrm { d } \theta$$
$$a_{t}=\frac{3g}{\pi}\sin(\varphi+\frac{\pi}{6})\approx0.614g$$
$$a_{t}=\frac{3g}{\pi}\sin(\varphi+\frac{\pi}{6})=\frac{\mathrm{d}\nu}{\mathrm{d}t}=\frac{\mathrm{d}\nu}{\mathrm{d}\varphi}\frac{\mathrm{d}\varphi}{\mathrm{d}t}=\frac{\nu}{R}\frac{\mathrm{d}\nu}{\mathrm{d}\varphi}$$
$$\nu \mathrm{d} \nu = \frac{3 g R}{\pi} \sin(\varphi + \frac{\pi}{6}) \mathrm{d} \varphi, \quad \int_{0}^{\nu} \nu \mathrm{d} \nu = \frac{3 g R}{\pi} \int_{0}^{\varphi} \sin(\varphi + \frac{\pi}{6}) \mathrm{d} \varphi$$
$$v = \sqrt{\frac{6gR}{\pi}} \left[ \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} - \cos\left(\varphi + \frac{\pi}{6}\right) \right] \approx 0.437\sqrt{gR}$$
(4)
$$\omega = \frac{v}{R}, \beta = \frac{a_{t}}{R}$$
$$v ^ { 2 } = \frac { 6 g R } { \pi } [ \frac { \sqrt { 3 } } { 2 } - \cos ( \varphi + \frac { \pi } { 6 } ) ] .$$
$$a_{C_{t}} = R_{C}\beta = R_{C}\frac{a_{t}}{R} = \frac{9g}{\pi^{2}}\sin(\varphi + \frac{\pi}{6})$$
$$a_{t}=\frac{3g}{\pi}\sin(\varphi+\frac{\pi}{6}),R_{c}=\frac{3R}{\pi}$$
$$a_{c}=R_{c}\omega^{2}=R_{c}(\frac{v}{R})^{2}=\frac{18g}{\pi^{2}}[\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}-\cos(\varphi+\frac{\pi}{6})]$$
$$N_{t}+mg\sin(\varphi+\frac{\pi}{6})=ma_{ct}=\frac{9mg}{\pi^{2}}\sin(\varphi+\frac{\pi}{6})$$
$$mg\cos(\varphi + \frac{\pi}{6}) + N_{n} = ma_{cn} = \frac{18mg}{\pi^{2}}\left[\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} - \cos(\varphi + \frac{\pi}{6})\right]$$
$$N _ { i } = m g ( \frac { 9 } { \pi ^ { 2 } } - 1 ) \sin ( \varphi + \frac { \pi } { 6 } ) \approx - 0 . 0 5 6 m g$$
$$N = \sqrt { N _ { t } ^ { 2 } + N _ { n } ^ { 2 } }$$
$$N _ { n } = - m g [ ( \frac { 1 8 } { \pi ^ { 2 } } + 1 ) \cos ( \varphi + \frac { \pi } { 6 } ) - \frac { 9 \sqrt { 3 } } { \pi ^ { 2 } } ] \approx - 0 . 5 8 4 m g$$
$$\approx 0 . 5 8 6 m g$$
(5)
$$\int \mathrm{d}mg \cos \theta + T \mathrm{d}\theta - \mathrm{d}N = \int \mathrm{d}m \frac{v^2}{R}$$
$$\mathrm{d}m = \lambda R \mathrm{d}\theta$$
$$\mathrm{d}N = \left( \lambda g R \cos \theta - \lambda v^{2} + T \right) \mathrm{d}\theta$$
$$\mathrm{d}N_{\min} = \left[ \lambda g R \cos(\varphi + \frac{\pi}{3}) - \lambda v^2 \right] \mathrm{d}\theta$$
$$\begin{aligned}= \lambda R g \left[ \cos \left( \varphi + \frac{\pi}{3} \right) + \frac{6}{\pi} \cos \left( \varphi + \frac{\pi}{6} \right) - \frac{3 \sqrt{3}}{\pi} \right] \mathrm{d} \theta\end{aligned}$$
$$\mathrm{d}N_{\min}\big|_{\varphi=\varphi_{c}}=0\Rightarrow\cos(\varphi_{c}+\frac{\pi}{3})+\frac{6}{\pi}\cos(\varphi_{c}+\frac{\pi}{6})=\frac{3\sqrt{3}}{\pi}$$
$$\varphi _ { c } \approx 0 . 2 4 2 \mathrm { r a d } \approx 1 3 . 9 ^ { \circ }$$
$$v ^ { 2 } = \frac { 6 g R } { \pi } [ \frac { \sqrt { 3 } } { 2 } - \cos ( \varphi + \frac { \pi } { 6 } ) ]$$

三（42分）如图，六根质量均为 $m$，长度均为 $l$ 的匀质刚性杆光滑铰接构成一个正六边形。初始时正六边形位于竖直面内，其最下方的 $AB$ 杆恰好水平并距地面 $2l$。正六边形由静止释放并与地面发生完全非弹性碰撞。已知重力加速度为 $g$。试求：

(1) $AB$ 杆触地后瞬间 $BC$ 杆转动的角速度；[14分]

(2) $AB$ 杆触地后瞬间 $BC$ 杆转动的角加速度；[14分]

(3) $BC$ 杆运动到水平位置（但未与地面发生碰撞）时的角速度。[14分]

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-3.png)
questions.analysis:
(1) $v_0 = 2\sqrt{gl}$

$$\left\{ I_{1x} \frac{\sqrt{3}l}{2} - I_{1y} \frac{l}{2} = -\frac{1}{3}ml^2\omega + mv_0\frac{l}{4} \right\}$$

$$I_{1x} + I_{2x} = mv_{Cx}$$

$$I_{1y} - I_{2y} = -mv_{Cy} + mv_0$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-答案-18.png)

$$\left[ I_{1y}\frac{l}{4} + I_{1x}\frac{\sqrt{3}l}{4} - I_{2x}\frac{\sqrt{3}l}{4} + I_{2y}\frac{l}{4} = \frac{1}{12}ml^2\omega \right]$$

$$\therefore I_{2y} = -mv_2 + mv_0$$

$$6v_2 = 18v_0 - 3\sqrt{3}v_{Cx} - 9v_{Cy} - 5l\omega$$

$$v_1 = l\omega$$

$$v_2\cos30^\circ = v_1\cos30^\circ$$

$$v_2 = v_1 = l\omega \quad (2)$$

$$v_{Cx} = \frac{1}{2}v_1\cos30^\circ = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}l\omega$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-答案-19.png)

$$v_{Cy} = \frac{1}{2}(v_1\sin30^\circ + v_2) = \frac{3}{4}l\omega$$

$$(1)\sim(4)\Rightarrow$$

$$\omega = \frac{9}{10}\frac{v_0}{l} = \frac{9}{5}\sqrt{\frac{g}{l}}$$

$$6v_2 = 18v_0 - 3\sqrt{3}v_0 = 9\sqrt{3} - 5l\omega$$

$$a_{1n} = l\omega^2$$

$$a_1 = l\beta$$

$$a_2\cos30^\circ - a_{1n}\cos60^\circ - a_{1t}\cos30^\circ = l\omega^2$$

$$a_2 = l\beta + \sqrt{3}l\omega^2$$

$$a_{Cx} = \frac{1}{2}(a_{1t}\cos30^\circ - a_{1n}\cos60^\circ) = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}l\beta - \frac{1}{4}l\omega^2$$

$$a_{Cy} = \frac{1}{2}(a_{1t}\cos60^\circ + a_{1n}\cos30^\circ + a_2) = \frac{3}{4}l\beta + \frac{3\sqrt{3}}{4}l\omega^2$$

$$(5)\sim(8)\Rightarrow$$

$$\beta = \frac{9}{10}\frac{g}{l} - \frac{3\sqrt{3}}{5}l\omega^2 = \left(\frac{9}{10} - \frac{243\sqrt{3}}{125}\right)\frac{g}{l} \approx -2.47\frac{g}{l}$$

$$6a_2 = 18g - 3\sqrt{3}a_{Cx} - 9a_{Cy} - 5l\beta \quad (5), \quad \omega = \frac{9}{5}\sqrt{\frac{g}{l}}$$

$$E_k + E_p = E_{kf} + E_{pf} \tag{5}$$

$$\frac{27}{5}mgl + 3\sqrt{3}mgl = \frac{14}{3}ml^2\omega_f^2 + 0$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-答案-20.png)

$$\sqrt{\left(\frac{81}{70} + \frac{9\sqrt{3}}{14}\right)\frac{g}{l}} \approx 1.51\sqrt{\frac{g}{l}}$$

$$E_k = \frac{27}{5}mgl, E_p = 3\sqrt{3}mgl, E_{kf} = \frac{14}{3}ml^2\omega_f^2, E_{pf} = 0$$

(2)

$$\left\{ F_{1x}\frac{\sqrt{3}l}{2} - F_{1y}\frac{l}{2} - mg\frac{l}{4} = -\frac{1}{3}ml^2\beta \right\}$$

$$F_{1x} + F_{2x} = ma_{Cx}$$

$$F_{1y} - F_{2y} - mg = -ma_{Cy}$$

$$\left| F_{1y}\frac{l}{4} + F_{1x}\frac{\sqrt{3}l}{4} - F_{2x}\frac{\sqrt{3}l}{4} + F_{2y}\frac{l}{4} \right| = \frac{1}{12}ml\beta$$

$$2F_{2y} - mg = -ma_2$$

$$6a_2 = 18g - 3\sqrt{3}a_{Cx} - 9a_{Cy} - 5l\beta$$

$$E_k = 2\times\frac{1}{2}\frac{1}{3}ml^2\omega^2 + 2\times\left[\frac{1}{2}m(v_{Cx}^2 + v_{Cy}^2) + \frac{1}{2}\frac{1}{12}ml^2\omega^2\right] + \frac{1}{2}mv_2^2$$

$$\frac{5}{3}ml^2\omega^2 = \frac{27}{5}mgl$$

$$\vec{E}_p = 6mg\cdot\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}l = 3\sqrt{3}mgl$$

$$v_{1f} = l\omega_f$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-答案-21.png)

$$v_{2f} = 2v_{1f} = 2l\omega_f$$

$$v_{Cf} = \frac{3}{2}v_{1f} = \frac{3}{2}l\omega_f$$

$$E_{kf} = 2\times\frac{1}{2}\frac{1}{3}ml^2\omega_f^2 + 2\times\left(\frac{1}{2}mv_{Cf}^2 + \frac{1}{2}\frac{1}{12}ml^2\omega_f^2\right) + \frac{1}{2}mv_{2f}^2 = \frac{14}{3}ml^2\omega_f^2$$

$$E_{pf} = 0$$

$$v_2 = l\omega, v_{Cx} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}l\omega, v_{Cy} = \frac{3}{4}l\omega, \omega = \frac{9}{5}\sqrt{\frac{g}{l}}$$

另解：(3)(2)

$$v_2' = 2l\cos\theta\cdot\omega$$

$$\left\{ J_P = \frac{1}{12}ml^2 + m\cdot\overline{CP}^2 \right.$$

$P$ 为瞬心

$$\overline{CP}^2 = \frac{l^2}{4} + 4l^2\cos^2\theta - 2\cdot\frac{l}{2}\cdot2l\cos\theta\cdot\cos\theta = \frac{l^2}{4} + 2l^2\cos^2\theta$$

$$J_P = -ml^2 + 2ml^2\cos^2\theta$$

$$E_k = 2\times\frac{1}{2}\frac{1}{3}ml^2\omega'^2 + 2\times\frac{1}{2}J_P\omega^2 + \frac{1}{2}mv_2'^2 = \left(\frac{2}{3} + 4\cos^2\theta\right)ml^2\omega'^2$$

$$E_p = 6mg\sin\theta$$

$$E_k + E_p = E_k' + E_p' \Rightarrow$$

$$\frac{27}{5}mgl + 3\sqrt{3}mgl = \left(\frac{2}{3} + 4\cos^2\theta\right)ml^2\omega'^2 + 6mgl\sin\theta$$

$$E_k = \frac{27}{5}mgl, E_p = 3\sqrt{3}mgl$$

(3)

五.（42分）如图所示是一个简化的电子透镜模型。一个导线圆环，半径为 $R$，通有沿图示方向的恒定电流，电流强度大小为 $I$。以圆环中心为原点，圆环轴向为 $z$ 轴建立图示的柱坐标系。电子发射器位于 $z$ 轴上 $z=-s$ 处（$s \gg R$），发射的电子的初速度大小均为 $v_0$，方向可能不同，但与 $z$ 轴的夹角都很小。用柱坐标 $(r,\theta,z)$ 表示电子在空间的位置。假设电子在运动过程中轴向速度远大于角向速度和径向速度，即 $|v_z| \gg |v_r|$，$|v_z| \gg |v_\theta|$。已知电子电量为 $-e$，质量为 $m$，不考虑相对论效应。其径向坐标 $r \ll R$。

（1）求圆环在电子所在位置 $(r,\theta,z)$ 产生的磁感应强度 $\vec{B}$；[10分]

（2）求当电子的位置坐标为 $(r,\theta,z)$ 时，电子绕 $z$ 轴的角速度 $\omega = \mathrm{d}\theta/\mathrm{d}t$；[12分]

（3）假设电子穿过电流环时，其径向坐标为 $r$，且在临近电流环的区域（磁力作用不可忽略的区域），径向坐标变化很小，可近似认为是一个常量。试计算电子通过电流环的磁场时径向（$r$ 方向）动量的改变量；[10分]

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-4.png)
questions.analysis:
(1) $B_\theta = 0$

$$B_z \approx \frac{\mu_0 I R^2}{2(z^2+R^2)^{3/2}}$$

$$\oint_S \vec{B}\cdot \mathrm{d}\vec{S}=0$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-答案-31.png)

$$(B_z+\mathrm{d}B_z)\cdot \pi r^2 - B_z\cdot \pi r^2 + B_r\cdot 2\pi r\mathrm{d}z=0$$

$$B_r = -\frac{r}{2}\frac{\mathrm{d}B_z}{\mathrm{d}z} = \frac{3\mu_0 I R^2 r z}{4(z^2+R^2)^{5/2}}$$

$$\vec{B}=B_z\vec{e}_z+B_r\vec{e}_r$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-答案-32.png)

$$\frac{\mu_0 I R^2}{2(z^2+R^2)^{3/2}}\left(\vec{e}_z+\frac{3rz}{2z^2+2R^2}\vec{e}_r\right)$$

(2)

$$\vec{B}=B_z\vec{e}_z+B_r\vec{e}_r,\quad \vec{v}=v_z\vec{e}_z+v_r\vec{e}_r+v_\theta\vec{e}_\theta$$

$$\vec{F}=-e\vec{v}\times\vec{B}=eB_r v_\theta\vec{e}_z - eB_z v_\theta\vec{e}_r + (eB_z v_r - eB_r v_z)\vec{e}_\theta$$

$$F_\theta = eB_z v_r - eB_r v_z = m\left(r\frac{\mathrm{d}^2\theta}{\mathrm{d}t^2}+2\frac{\mathrm{d}r}{\mathrm{d}t}\frac{\mathrm{d}\theta}{\mathrm{d}t}\right)$$

$$eB_z v_r - eB_r v_z = eB_z\frac{\mathrm{d}r}{\mathrm{d}t}+\frac{er}{2}\frac{\mathrm{d}B_z}{\mathrm{d}z}\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{\mathrm{d}t}=eB_z\frac{\mathrm{d}r}{\mathrm{d}t}+\frac{er}{2}\frac{\mathrm{d}B_z}{\mathrm{d}t}=\frac{e}{2r}\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}(r^2B_z)$$

$$m\left(r\frac{\mathrm{d}^2\theta}{\mathrm{d}t^2}+2\frac{\mathrm{d}r}{\mathrm{d}t}\frac{\mathrm{d}\theta}{\mathrm{d}t}\right)=\frac{m}{r}\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\left(r^2\frac{\mathrm{d}\theta}{\mathrm{d}t}\right)$$

$$\frac{e}{2r}\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}(r^2B_z)=\frac{m}{r}\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\left(r^2\frac{\mathrm{d}\theta}{\mathrm{d}t}\right)$$

$$\frac{e}{2}\mathrm{d}(r^2B_z)=m\mathrm{d}(r^2\dot{\theta})\quad(\dot{\theta}=\frac{\mathrm{d}\theta}{\mathrm{d}t})$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-答案-33.png)

$$B_r=-\frac{r}{2}\frac{\mathrm{d}B_z}{\mathrm{d}z}$$

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}\theta}{\mathrm{d}t}=\dot{\theta}=\frac{e}{2m}B_z=\frac{\mu_0 e I R^2}{4m(z^2+R^2)^{3/2}}$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-答案-34.png)

$$\frac{e}{2}\mathrm{d}(r^2B_z)=m\mathrm{d}\left(r^2\frac{\mathrm{d}\theta}{\mathrm{d}t}\right),\quad B_z=\frac{\mu_0 I R^2}{2(z^2+R^2)^{3/2}}$$

$$\frac{e}{2}\int_0^{r^2B_z}\mathrm{d}(r^2B_z)=m\int_0^{r^2\dot{\theta}}\mathrm{d}(r^2\dot{\theta})$$

$$\frac{e}{2}r^2B_z=mr^2\dot{\theta}$$

$$F_r=ma_r=m\left[\frac{\mathrm{d}v_r}{\mathrm{d}t}-r\left(\frac{\mathrm{d}\theta}{\mathrm{d}t}\right)^2\right]$$

(3)

$$\mathrm{d}p_r=\frac{\mathrm{d}p_r}{\mathrm{d}t}-mr\left(\frac{\mathrm{d}\theta}{\mathrm{d}t}\right)^2$$

$$\frac{\mathrm{d}p_r}{\mathrm{d}t}=F_r+mr\left(\frac{\mathrm{d}\theta}{\mathrm{d}t}\right)^2$$

$$-ev_\theta B_z+mr\left(\frac{\mathrm{d}\theta}{\mathrm{d}t}\right)^2=-er\frac{\mathrm{d}\theta}{\mathrm{d}t}B_z+mr\left(\frac{\mathrm{d}\theta}{\mathrm{d}t}\right)^2=-\frac{e^2rB_z^2}{4m}$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-答案-35.png)

$$\mathrm{d}p_r=-\frac{e^2rB_z^2}{4m}\mathrm{d}t\approx-\frac{e^2rB_z^2}{4m}\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{v_0}=-\frac{\mu_0^2e^2rI^2R^4}{16mv_0}\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{(z^2+R^2)^3}$$

$$\vec{F}=eB_rv_\theta\vec{e}_z-eB_zv_\theta\vec{e}_r+(eB_zv_r-eB_rv_z)\vec{e}_\theta,\quad B_z=\frac{\mu_0 I R^2}{2(z^2+R^2)^{3/2}},\quad \frac{\mathrm{d}\theta}{\mathrm{d}t}=\frac{eB_z}{2m}$$

$$\Delta p_r=-\frac{\mu_0^2e^2I^2rR^4}{16mv_0}\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{\mathrm{d}z}{(z^2+R^2)^3}=-\frac{3\pi\mu_0^2e^2I^2r}{128mv_0R}$$

(4)

$$p_r=p_0\sin\alpha\approx mv_0\frac{r}{s}$$

$$p_r'=-p_0\sin\beta\approx-mv_0\frac{r}{s'}$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-答案-36.png)

$$\Delta p_r=p_r'-p_r\approx-mv_0r\left(\frac{1}{s}+\frac{1}{s'}\right)$$

$$\frac{1}{s}+\frac{1}{s'}=-\frac{\Delta p_r}{mv_0r}=\frac{3\pi}{128R}\left(\frac{\mu_0 e I}{mv_0}\right)^2$$

$$\frac{1}{s}+\frac{1}{s'}=\frac{1}{f}$$

与薄透镜成像公式相同！

$$f=\frac{128}{3\pi}R\left(\frac{mv_0}{\mu_0 e I}\right)^2$$

$$\Delta p_r=-\frac{3\pi\mu_0^2e^2I^2r}{128mv_0R}$$

八.（42分）惯性系 $S$、$S'$ 间相对运动关系如图示，$S'$ 相对于 $S$ 以速度 $v$ 沿 $x$ 轴方向作匀速运动，两坐标原点 $O$、$O'$ 重合时，两参照系中的时间 $t=t'=0$。一静长度为 $l_0$，折射率为 $n$ 的玻璃棒静止于 $S'$ 系中，棒的一端与 $O'$ 重合，棒身与 $O'x'$ 轴的夹角为 $\theta_0$。在 $S'$ 系中 $O'$ 处有一点光源，$t'=0$ 时刻点光源发出一光脉冲，持续时间为 $n l_0/c$（$c$ 为真空中的光速），该脉冲在玻璃棒内沿棒方向传播。试求：

（1）$S$ 系测得，玻璃棒的长度和玻璃棒与 $Ox$ 轴的夹角；[8分]

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-7.png)

（2）$S$ 系测得，光脉冲在玻璃棒中的传播方向与 $Ox$ 的夹角；[8分]

（3）$S$ 系测得，玻璃棒被照亮的长度与时间 $t$ 的关系。[26分]
questions.analysis:
（1）$l_x'=l_0\cos\theta_0$，$l_y'=l_0\sin\theta_0$

$$l_x=l_x'\sqrt{1-\beta^2}=l_0\cos\theta_0\sqrt{1-\beta^2}\quad(\beta=\frac{v}{c})$$

$$l_y=l_y'=l_0\sin\theta_0$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-答案-46.png)

$$l=\sqrt{l_x^2+l_y^2}=l_0\sqrt{1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0}$$

$$\tan\theta=\frac{l_y}{l_x}=\frac{\tan\theta_0}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}$$

（2）$u'=c/n$

$$u_x'=\frac{c}{n}\cos\theta_0,\quad u_y'=\frac{c}{n}\sin\theta_0$$

$$u_x=\frac{u_x'+v}{1+u_x'v/c^2}=\frac{nv+c\cos\theta_0}{nc+v\cos\theta_0}c$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-答案-47.png)

$$u_y=\frac{u_y'\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}}{1+u_x'v/c^2}=\frac{\sin\theta_0\sqrt{c^2-v^2}}{nc+v\cos\theta_0}c$$

$$\tan\theta_{\text{光}}=\frac{u_y}{u_x}=\frac{\sin\theta_0\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}{n\beta+\cos\theta_0}\quad(\beta=\frac{v}{c})$$

（3）阶段1：脉冲未停止发射，且光线未出玻璃棒。

$$S':\ x'=\frac{c}{n}t'\cos\theta_0,\ y'=\frac{c}{n}t'\sin\theta_0$$

$$x=\frac{x'+vt'}{\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}}=\frac{nv+c\cos\theta_0}{n\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}}t'$$

$$y=y'=\frac{c}{n}t'\sin\theta_0$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-答案-48.png)

$$t=\frac{t'+vx'/c^2}{\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}}=\frac{nc+v\cos\theta_0}{nc\sqrt{1-v^2/c^2}}t'$$

$$x=\frac{nv+c\cos\theta_0}{nc+v\cos\theta_0}ct$$

$$y=\frac{\sin\theta_0\sqrt{c^2-v^2}}{nc+v\cos\theta_0}ct$$

$$d_{\text{亮}}=\sqrt{(x-vt)^2+y^2}=\frac{\sqrt{(1-\beta^2)(1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0)}}{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}ct$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-答案-49.png)

条件：$t'\leq nl_0/c$，$l_{\text{光}}\leq l$

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-答案-50.png)

$$t\leq\frac{n}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}\frac{l_0}{c}\equiv t_{\text{停发}}$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-答案-51.png)

$$l_{\text{亮}}=\frac{\sqrt{(1-\beta^2)(1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0)}}{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}ct,\quad l=l_0\sqrt{1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0}$$

阶段2：脉冲已停止发射，但光线未出玻璃棒。

$$t=t_{\text{停发}}=\frac{nl_0}{c\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}$$

$$l_{\text{亮}}=\frac{\sqrt{1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0}}{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}nl_0$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-答案-52.png)

条件：$t_{\text{停发}}<t\leq t_{\text{出棒}}$

$$\frac{nl_0}{c\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}<t\leq\frac{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}\frac{l_0}{c}$$

$$l_{\text{亮}}=\frac{\sqrt{(1-\beta^2)(1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0)}}{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}ct$$

阶段3：光线已出玻璃棒，但未离开玻璃棒。

假想玻璃棒外的折射率与玻璃棒相同。

$$l=l_0\sqrt{1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0}$$

$$r=\frac{\sqrt{(1-\beta^2)(1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0)}}{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}ct$$

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-答案-53.png)

$$l_s=\frac{\sqrt{1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0}}{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}nl_0$$

假想光源持续发光

$$l_{\text{亮}}=l-(r-l_s)=\frac{\left[(2n+\beta\cos\theta_0)l_0-\sqrt{1-\beta^2}ct\right]\sqrt{1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0}}{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}$$

条件：$t_{\text{出棒}}<t\leq t_{\text{离棒}}$

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-答案-54.png)

$$t_{\text{离棒}}=\frac{2n+\beta\cos\theta_0}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}\frac{l_0}{c}$$

阶段4：光线已离开玻璃棒

$$l_{\text{亮}}=0$$

条件：$t>t_{\text{离棒}}$

![](data/images/2021-9-b237abe7/2021-苏国珍-未标期次-第一套-答案-55.png)
questions.answer:
（1）玻璃棒长度 $l=l_0\sqrt{1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0}$，与 $Ox$ 轴夹角 $\tan\theta=\dfrac{\tan\theta_0}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}$。

（2）光脉冲传播方向与 $Ox$ 轴夹角 $\tan\theta_{\text{光}}=\dfrac{\sin\theta_0\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}{n\beta+\cos\theta_0}$。

（3）玻璃棒被照亮的长度 $l_{\text{亮}}$ 随时间 $t$ 分段变化：

- 阶段1（$t\leq\dfrac{n}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}\dfrac{l_0}{c}$）：$l_{\text{亮}}=\dfrac{\sqrt{(1-\beta^2)(1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0)}}{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}ct$；
- 阶段2（$\dfrac{n}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}\dfrac{l_0}{c}<t\leq\dfrac{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}\dfrac{l_0}{c}$）：$l_{\text{亮}}=\dfrac{\sqrt{1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0}}{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}nl_0$；
- 阶段3（$\dfrac{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}\dfrac{l_0}{c}<t\leq\dfrac{2n+\beta\cos\theta_0}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}\dfrac{l_0}{c}$）：$l_{\text{亮}}=\dfrac{\left[(2n+\beta\cos\theta_0)l_0-\sqrt{1-\beta^2}ct\right]\sqrt{1-\beta^2\cos^2\theta_0}}{n+\beta\cos\theta_0}$；
- 阶段4（$t>\dfrac{2n+\beta\cos\theta_0}{\sqrt{1-\beta^2}}\dfrac{l_0}{c}$）：$l_{\text{亮}}=0$。
